subject.title: fix(matrix): deliver reasoning blocks as m.notice when /reasoning on [AI-assisted]

question: After the branch is rebased to use `reasoningPayloadsEnabled`, should this external Matrix PR require live Matrix/Element send-read proof before merge, or may maintainers waive that and accept the adapter proof?
rationale: Repository policy asks for real behavior proof for external PRs, while this contributor disclosed they lack Matrix homeserver credentials and only provided terminal output from a recording adapter.

options.title: Require live Matrix proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Matrix/Element room transcript, logs, or recording that shows `/reasoning on` delivering an `m.notice` and `/reasoning off` hiding it before merge.

options.title: Waive live proof after repair
options.body: Accept the in-memory adapter proof only after the code reuses `reasoningPayloadsEnabled` and current CI remains clean.

options.title: Pause if proof is unavailable
options.body: Leave the PR open or close it later if the contributor cannot provide proof and no maintainer wants to sponsor a live Matrix validation.

recommendation.title: Require live Matrix proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Matrix/Element room transcript, logs, or recording that shows `/reasoning on` delivering an `m.notice` and `/reasoning off` hiding it before merge.
